_spec: Soak scenario (stability). The 'scenarios' entry below is compiled into
fails if the two differ, so edit both together.
(netsim wifi, 9 arena blocks x 10 rounds = 90 rounds, ~40 s each => ~60 min). Each round: Live, 12 s fight,
a 3 s blackout burst on the seat's client (alternating), 12 s fight, DEBUG KILL; then RoundOver + countdown.
Every arena is visited (Alley..EastTower, then Alley, Pit). Quick variant: soak_10m.json.
SOAK-CRASH  hsmp-tools crash-triage over the run window (<run>/crash_triage.json, written by mp_test.ps1 or by
the gate itself): new dumps <= crashes_max (0), each reported with its signature; every game alive at quit_all.
SOAK-MEM    <run>/mem.jsonl from 'hsmp-gate memwatch' (private bytes / working set / handles per tracked process
every mem_sample_s). Per game, samples after mem_warmup_min: least-squares slope < mem_slope_max_mb_per_h,
peak - median(first 3 post-warm-up samples) <= mem_growth_max_mb, handle slope <= handle_slope_max_per_h;
server/sidecar slope <= aux_mem_slope_max_mb_per_h. Fewer than mem_min_samples post-warm-up samples = incomplete.
SOAK-LUAERR UE4SS.log Lua errors (LUA_ERR*, 'attempt to <op>', 'stack traceback', '<file>.lua:<n>:' error text,
'bad argument #') and hsmp_log lua_error events <= lua_errors_max (0); lua_error_allow = regexes to ignore.
SOAK-HITCH  hitch events with ms > hitch_max_ms outside travel (travel=true, or between a travel and that instance's
next world_ready) fail; needs HSMPDiag (dev profile) evidence, else incomplete.

soak_60m.doc: Soak: 2 instances, ~60 min, 9 arena blocks x 10 rounds via RCON DEBUG KILL, every arena, netsim wifi + a 3 s blackout per round; 0 crashes, memory slope/growth bounded, 0 Lua errors, no hitch > 2 s
